scope.corrected_tail_readiness: Root explicitly confirmed installed stable INFO/JPG before this review opened tail media; tail-install SHA prefix supplied: 3392e5f0.
scope.identity_limit: Directly verifies image/INFO byte hashes below. Does not certify overall export provenance or issue a gate decision.

method: Opened all 24 original s060.0.jpg–s083.0.jpg via view_image; all 30 actual cells per full sheet and all 3 actual cells in last sheet, no sampling.
Read INFO words/cues from all three chunks. Audio strips and cue markers were not treated as hearing audio.
Opened all 19 unique flagged raw JPEG frames plus neighbors/context/fade: 52 raw images total at entire 960x540 view.
Hashed every sheet and INFO before/after inspection. All unchanged. SHA for every visually opened raw frame recorded.
Performed lightweight read-only pixel extrema scan of all 693 raw JPEGs and brightness measurement across fade; this numerical scan is separate from visual opening proof.
Only reports/scratch were written. No project source, VERDICT or JURI writes; no renders.
limitations: No audio was played or heard from strips. All eight SFX? entries remain audio-unassessed even where the visual event is explained.
Canonical raw JPEGs are 960x540; sheet cells are smaller. This is not 1920x1080 pixel-detail certification.
Natural-speed perceptual severity of the two short camera plateaus remains a native-playback judgment.
This report covers corrected c07–c09; it does not re-certify earlier chunks, B19 candidate changes or later film/audio provenance.

findings.summary: Pose kamera ditahan tiga frame ketika blur gerak masih aktif sebelum gerak berlanjut.
findings.evidence: 52 raw JPEG dibuka termasuk seluruh pasangan/neighbor yang disebut. f2123=f2124 byte-identik; f2122→2123 dan f2338→2339→2340 berubah sangat sedikit pada isi/teks, sementara pose kamera/blur tetap sama. Ini bukan full-frame freeze.
findings.context_impact: Kata/frasa tetap utuh sesudah gerak; konteks Apa di B25 tetap tersedia dan tidak terpotong.
findings.source_cause: camPath b24Cam/b25Cam menerima useCurrentFrame lama di dalam Main Freeze(W); pembulatan W menahan old2422 dan old2687 selama tiga actual frame.
findings.recommendation: Nilai f2119–2130 dan f2334–2344 pada playback native untuk menentukan apakah plateau terasa menahan gerak. Jika perlu polish, interpolasi clock kamera/blur lokal dengan anchor dan cut tetap; jangan mengubah peta global, layout, wording, atau gaya scroll yang disetujui.
findings.related_but_not_same_defect: f2270–2272 juga mengulang old2578; footage wajah di lampiran tetap bergerak dan apa terbaca. Tidak dinilai sebagai kehilangan konteks atau full freeze.

scope_observations.blank_flashing: No unintended blank/full-black flash observed in any of the 693 cells. Independent extrema scan found only f2492 fully black; 692 tail frames contain nonblack pixels.
scope_observations.end_fade: Raw f2477/2478/2480/2483/2486/2489/2490/2491/2492 opened. Brightness decreases from f2479 through f2492; f2491 max RGB still [2,2,3], f2492 all channels zero. EndFade source explicitly ends at duration-1.
scope_observations.B25_Apa: Raw f2267 shows dark apa against scrim. First full phrase f2289; second full phrase f2320; apa pengalaman visible after scroll f2342–2353; yang aku dapatkan full f2369 and held through f2387. No context/crop defect confirmed.
scope_observations.B25_caption_change: f2354 has a one-frame empty caption at phrase swap, while UI/wall stays visible; yang appears f2355. Treated as brief caption transition, not blank export or a new requested design change.
scope_observations.foreground_bounds: No new destructive foreground word crop/collision confirmed. Text from earlier posts leaving the top during scroll follows completed readable context.
scope_observations.creator_leak: No new external YouTube creator photo/name/avatar leak observed. Tail shows own repo/app UI and intentional Irfan face/avatar; no external YouTube content slot was newly visible here.
scope_observations.pauses: Small old-clock plateaus measured; they do not remove caption context. f2270–2272 includes continuing face video, not a frozen full image.
